reconciliation.cultural_frame: 19 local-knowledge cultural claims (12 dishes, 5 dialect profiles, 2 non-Arabic languages) at local_reported/probable status, unpublished; shared dishes carry shared classification, never exclusive ownership.
reconciliation.district_frame: 333 districts attested across 22 first-level units; identities reconciled from the NIC catalogue mirror and the 2004 census frame; individual identities carry probable status pending an atomic official coded register.
reconciliation.dress_crafts_markets_frame: 14 local-knowledge claims (7 dress, 4 crafts, 3 markets) at local_reported status, unpublished, with explicit classification; regional dress names documented down to district level (Taiz rural costumes).
reconciliation.lane_frame: Amanat 2004 frame: 791 lanes across 10 districts plus two suburb blocks; 104 lane identities attested for Old Sanaa (69) and Tahrir (35); remaining 687 lanes are a documented open frame, never fabricated.
reconciliation.socotra_effective_date_basis: Law reported issued 2013-12-18; Yemen laws ordinarily state operation from issuance, but the complete official text locator remains a documented source-access limitation.
reconciliation.urban_sections_frame: Depth cycle 2: named urban sections of Amanat Al Asimah districts enumerated from a dated OpenStreetMap snapshot (2026-09-23) and mirrored as checksum-bound extracts; GNS-tagged sections carry probable status, community-mapped names stay unverified, and the still-open districts are recorded with the retrieval failure instead of being estimated.
